sourceIssues.finding: The lecture title names DH parameters, but pages 212–242 develop spatial representations, not a DH parameter table or the four-parameter DH transform.

sourceIssues.finding: Compact ^A P=T ^B P notation precedes the 4x4 homogeneous matrix without visibly appending 1 to each Cartesian point symbol.
